caption:
The night prayer and Witr

Sahih al-Bukhari 990 (Book 14, Hadith 1), narrated by Ibn Umar: the night prayer is two rak'ahs by two, and whoever fears the dawn prays one rak'ah, which makes his prayer Witr. Shown in Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Arabic and English are from hadith-api. The Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish are Claude's own translations from the verified Arabic and English, as no edition exists in those languages. Sources on the final frame.

Background footage is AI-generated (altered or synthetic content).

#Witr #Hadith #IslamicReminder #NightPrayer #Sunnah
